Sounds cool, what is it?

[quote=italian_dutch;60284206]What is it?[/quote]
Every 10 years, during the Hli Hnab(month) Summer solstice, representing the triuph of light over darkness,like Xyoj Yee did to the Ntseem, a large black flag is burnt in the middle of Npaidi Plaza(Xausqhov Ntseemeb)to represent the start of the festival, which lasts for about three days, three of which are full of competitions and games.
The games include duels body to body, crossbow competition, and horse racing, those who pass all the challenges will have the right to make directly a wish for the person between man and spirits, the Txohawj of course
Sportsmanship is esentiall, no cheating is allowed during the Koob Xyoj Yee, and the duels are made with wooden swords, until the first fall with their total back touching ground,or surrender.
Xyoj clan is treated just as any other people, the event is hosted by the shamans and the Txohawj, the event traces to even before Zhumiao being united,some say it has a history from ever since Xyoj Yee founded it,while keejs insist it is from the period of fracture when the Kingdom fallen.
Anyone is invited to participate, this year's champion, the Solstice Champion is Kong Thauv,the clan is,as mentioned, what they are known for,not all they do and will, Kong Thauv wish was to request the Txohawj for more knowledge from the libraries of Npaidi, second him the entirety of Zhumiao libraries contacting manuscripts and texts are unmatched to whatever is that the libraries of Tsevntuj thaj yeeb hide.
The person may ask for anything, wealth,status, knowledge, anything they want, they may choose to remain "unknown" until next year, the champion who wish not be named nor his wish to be made public will have his decision respected and will not be revealed until next champion arrive, which will be...next year Solstice to be more precise (2026)
The three days have three challenges, the day is the Kevsib Nees, horse competition,a racing between 20 people, the 12 who pass will go to the next game on next day, kevsib hlainpauj, the dispute last all day, morning, afternoon and night, at morning 6 who scored most will remain in game, then at afternoon only 4 will be left, and then at the end of day, only 2 will remain, and pass to the third and last challenge, the Kevsib Hnab, duel of sun, the last two competitors will fight until one surrenders or fall completely on the ground, the one who win, can make his wish.
